chrome_custom_side.description: Long, curved and shiny. Leans the bike right over, chopper style.

basic_centre.name: Basic centre stand
basic_centre.description: Holds the bike upright with the back wheel off the ground.

heavy_centre.name: Heavy-duty centre stand
heavy_centre.description: Braced legs for big tourers and loaded bikes.

lever_centre.name: Easy-lift centre stand
lever_centre.description: A long lever foot so anyone can heave the bike up.

alloy_centre.name: Alloy centre stand
alloy_centre.description: Light alloy legs. Saves weight, still lifts the wheel.

chrome_centre.name: Chrome centre stand
chrome_centre.description: Classic chrome legs for a show bike.

round_7.name: 7" round halogen headlight
round_7.description: The classic round lamp. Warm and dim by modern standards.

bates_cafe.name: Bates-style café lamp
bates_cafe.description: Small chrome bucket lamp for a café racer.

twin_round.name: Twin round headlights
twin_round.description: A pair of small round lamps side by side.

rect_enduro.name: Enduro number-plate light
rect_enduro.description: Rectangular lamp in a plastic plate. Shrugs off roost.

led_projector.name: LED projector headlight
led_projector.description: Modern projector lens with a crisp white beam.

chrome_ring_7.name: 7" headlight with chrome ring
chrome_ring_7.description: Big round lamp with a chrome bezel and chrome ears.

nacelle_lamp.name: Headlight nacelle
nacelle_lamp.description: The headlamp sunk into a pressed-steel cowl over the fork tops, clock and all.

cafe_grille_lamp.name: Bucket lamp with stone grille
cafe_grille_lamp.description: Small bucket lamp with a mesh stone guard across the lens.

cafe_visor_lamp.name: Visored chrome lamp
cafe_visor_lamp.description: Round chrome headlight with a peaked visor over the lens.

bobber_bullet_lamp.name: Bullet headlight
bobber_bullet_lamp.description: A long chrome bullet lamp on side brackets.

bobber_black_bucket.name: Black bucket lamp with visor
bobber_black_bucket.description: A little black bucket with a peaked visor.

chopper_bullet_long.name: Long chrome bullet lamp
chopper_bullet_long.description: A big chrome bullet on long brackets off the springer.

chopper_stacked.name: Stacked twin lamps
chopper_stacked.description: Two small lamps stacked one over the other.

cruiser_visor_7.name: 7" lamp with visor and ring
cruiser_visor_7.description: Big chrome lamp with a visor and chrome trim ring.

cruiser_quad_bar.name: Spotlamp bar and headlight
cruiser_quad_bar.description: A big headlamp flanked by a pair of lamps on a chrome bar.

scrambler_grille_7.name: 7" lamp with stone guard
scrambler_grille_7.description: Big round lamp with a criss-cross grille.

mx_number_lamp.name: Number plate lamp
mx_number_lamp.description: A small square lamp in a number plate.

sm_plate_lamp.name: Motard number lamp, black
sm_plate_lamp.description: Small lamp in a black plate.

sm_led_plate.name: LED motard plate
sm_led_plate.description: Modern LED projector in a slim mask.

adv_twin_led.name: Twin rally lamps
adv_twin_led.description: Twin round lamps under a rally screen.

adv_quad.name: Quad LED lamp
adv_quad.description: Four LED cells in a square mask.

bugeye_twin.name: Twin bug-eye headlights
bugeye_twin.description: A pair of small oval lamps set close together and angled out like a wasp's eyes, on a short bracket under a little fly-screen. The 90s streetfighter look.

square_chrome.name: Square headlight, chrome bezel
square_chrome.description: A big rectangular lamp of the 70s and 80s: fluted glass in a chrome bezel, on chrome ears.

square_xl.name: Extra-large square headlight
square_xl.description: A great slab of a rectangular lamp in a black bezel, like an 80s desert racer or a big tourer wore. Fluted glass and plenty of light.

triple_led.name: Twin LED streetfighter headlights
triple_led.description: Two slim, angular LED lamps swept back like narrowed eyes, with daytime running lights along their brows. The look of today's big British triples.

triple_led_rs.name: Twin LED streetfighter headlights, alloy
triple_led_rs.description: The same angular LED pair in a brushed alloy housing, with bright running-light brows.

disc_horn.name: Stock disc horn
disc_horn.description: The little round horn every bike leaves the factory with. A polite meep.

twin_tone.name: Twin-tone horns
twin_tone.description: A high and a low disc wired together. Proper car-horn chord.

snail_horn.name: Snail horns
snail_horn.description: Spiral trumpets in a pair. Loud, clear and a bit European.

air_horn.name: Compressed air horn
air_horn.description: Twin chrome trumpets and a tiny compressor. Makes car drivers jump.

train_horn.name: Freight train horn
train_horn.description: Three trumpets tuned to a train chord. Completely unnecessary.

klaxon.name: Vintage klaxon
klaxon.description: The old mechanical AOOGA. Hand-polished brass bell.

bulb_horn.name: Rubber bulb horn
bulb_horn.description: Squeeze it. Honk. A clown car classic.

scooter_beep.name: Scooter beeper
scooter_beep.description: A thin electronic beep-beep, like a moped in a hurry.

musical_horn.name: La Cucaracha musical horn
musical_horn.description: Five trumpets that play the tune. Every shed needs one.

goose_horn.name: Goose honker
goose_horn.description: A wheezy reed horn that sounds exactly like an angry goose.

low_tone_horn.name: Low-tone disc horn
low_tone_horn.description: A deep, flat-fronted disc horn. Sounds like it belongs on something bigger.

high_tone_horn.name: High-tone disc horn
high_tone_horn.description: A bright, piercing disc horn that cuts through traffic noise.

pip_horn.name: Courtesy pip horn
pip_horn.description: A short, friendly pip, however long you lean on the button. Very British.

truck_air_horn.name: Truck air horn
truck_air_horn.description: A single chrome trumpet off a lorry, with its own little compressor.

police_horn.name: Police yelp horn
police_horn.description: A siren speaker that whoops and yelps while you hold the button. Strictly for the shed.

ship_horn.name: Ship's foghorn
ship_horn.description: A full ocean-liner blast on every press. A joke that never gets old (for you).

tug_horn.name: Tugboat horn
tug_horn.description: A harbour tug's cheerful blast. Every press is the whole thing.

stock_ecu.name: Stock ECU
stock_ecu.description: Basic engine control: fuel and ignition maps, nothing else. No rider aids.

remap_ecu.name: Performance remap ECU
remap_ecu.description: Hotter maps and a higher rev limit. More power, still no aids.

abs_ecu.name: ABS controller
abs_ecu.description: Adds anti-lock brakes front and rear. Stamp on the brakes without locking a wheel.

sport_ecu.name: Sport ride-by-wire ECU
sport_ecu.description: Traction control, ABS and anti-wheelie in one box. Set up for fast road riding.

race_ecu.name: Race ECU with IMU
race_ecu.description: Lean-sensitive traction control, cornering ABS, wheelie and stability control. Lets the rider push but catches the big mistakes.

canvas_throwover.name: Canvas throw-over panniers
canvas_throwover.description: Waxed canvas bags slung over the seat. Cheap and cheerful.

leather_saddlebags.name: Leather saddlebags
leather_saddlebags.description: Studded leather bags with buckles. Pure cruiser.

adventure_soft.name: Adventure soft bags
adventure_soft.description: Tough nylon dry bags on a rack. Crash-proof and waterproof.

plastic_cases.name: Hard plastic cases
plastic_cases.description: Lockable side cases, colour-matched lids. Swallow a helmet each.

aluminium_boxes.name: Aluminium adventure boxes
aluminium_boxes.description: Square riveted alloy boxes for crossing continents. Dent, don't break.

cruiser_leather_saddlebags.name: Leather saddlebags, studded
cruiser_leather_saddlebags.description: Tall black leather saddlebags with chrome buckles.

cruiser_hard_bags.name: Painted hard saddlebags
cruiser_hard_bags.description: Paint-matched hard bags with a rounded lid. The bagger look.

adv_alloy_trunks_silver.name: Expedition alloy side boxes, 90 L
adv_alloy_trunks_silver.description: Big square alloy boxes on a steel rack. Pack for a month.

adv_hard_side_cases.name: Adventure hard side cases, grey
adv_hard_side_cases.description: Tough plastic side cases with alloy lids on a quick-release rack.

adv_slim_soft_cases.name: Slim soft side bags, olive
adv_slim_soft_cases.description: Slim roll-top bags on a light rack. Narrow enough for the trail.

top_box_30.name: 30 L top box
top_box_30.description: Small plastic box on a rack. Fits a lid and lunch.

top_box_45.name: 45 L top box
top_box_45.description: Takes two full-face helmets, with a backrest pad for the pillion.

alloy_top_box.name: Aluminium top case
alloy_top_box.description: Riveted alloy box to match the adventure panniers.

wooden_crate.name: Rack-mounted crate
wooden_crate.description: An old wooden crate bolted to a rack. Hipster delivery rider chic.

leather_trunk.name: Leather tour trunk
leather_trunk.description: A stitched leather trunk on a chrome rack. Old-school touring.

roll_bag.name: Waterproof roll bag
roll_bag.description: A 40 L dry bag strapped across the rack, both ends rolled down and clipped. Light, and shrugs off the rain.

adv_alloy_top_55.name: Expedition alloy top box, 55 L
adv_alloy_top_55.description: A big riveted alloy top box on the rack. Two helmets and the stove.

adv_black_top_42.name: Black alloy top box, 42 L
adv_black_top_42.description: A black anodised alloy top case to match the black side boxes.

adv_plastic_top_50.name: Adventure top case, 50 L
adv_plastic_top_50.description: A big plastic top case with a pillion backrest. Light and lockable.

halogen_spots.name: Round halogen spotlights
halogen_spots.description: A pair of small chrome spots on the crash bars.

led_pods.name: LED cube pods
led_pods.description: Square LED pods. Turn the night white.

rally_lamps.name: Rally lamps
rally_lamps.description: Big round lamps with stone guards, Dakar style.

amber_fogs.name: Amber fog lights
amber_fogs.description: Yellow lenses that cut through mist and look the part.

light_bar.name: LED light bar
light_bar.description: A slim bar of LEDs across the forks. Enormous throw.

classic_mudguard.name: Long classic mudguard
classic_mudguard.description: A full-length steel guard following the back tyre, with a chunky rear lamp and the plate on top. Keeps the spray off.

cafe_tail.name: Cafe racer tail hump
cafe_tail.description: A fibreglass seat cowl with a little round lamp let into its tail and a short hugger underneath.

scrambler_loop.name: Scrambler loop and short fender
scrambler_loop.description: A bent steel hoop closing off the subframe, a stubby fender and a lamp on a bracket. Old-school dirt style.

sport_tail_tidy.name: Sport tail tidy
sport_tail_tidy.description: Ditches the long hanger for a neat undertray, a slim LED strip and the plate tucked up on a short arm.

bobber_fender.name: Bobber chopped fender
bobber_fender.description: A short steel fender hugging the tyre, a bullet lamp on top and the plate hung off the side.

enduro_fender.name: Enduro high fender
enduro_fender.description: A long plastic blade swept up high out of the mud, with a tiny LED lamp under its tip.

classic_tombstone_guard.name: Chrome guard with tombstone lamp
classic_tombstone_guard.description: Full chrome rear guard with the upright tombstone tail lamp.

painted_valance_guard.name: Painted full guard, stripe
painted_valance_guard.description: Deep painted rear guard with a single pinstripe and round lamp.

cafe_ducktail.name: Ducktail seat cowl
cafe_ducktail.description: Fibreglass tail that kicks up at the end, with a strip lamp under the lip.

cafe_hump_cowl_striped.name: Hump cowl, racing stripe
cafe_hump_cowl_striped.description: A tall fibreglass hump with a racing stripe and a little round lamp.

cafe_solo_cowl.name: Round solo cowl
cafe_solo_cowl.description: A rounded solo cowl with a back stop, like a 60s production racer.

bobber_cateye_fender.name: Bobbed fender, cateye lamp
bobber_cateye_fender.description: A short bobbed fender with a chrome cateye lamp on top.

bobber_tombstone_fender.name: Bobbed fender, tombstone lamp
bobber_tombstone_fender.description: Short steel fender, side plate and an upright tombstone lamp.

chopper_cateye_stub.name: Stub fender, cateye lamp, struts
chopper_cateye_stub.description: Short chopped fender on chrome struts with a cateye lamp.

chopper_sissy_fender.name: Ribbed fender, twin lamps
chopper_sissy_fender.description: Ribbed steel fender with twin round lamps.

cruiser_ribbed_fender.name: Ribbed fender, tombstone lamp
cruiser_ribbed_fender.description: A long ribbed rear fender with a tombstone lamp.

cruiser_halo_fender.name: Full fender, halo LED
cruiser_halo_fender.description: Long painted fender with a modern ring LED lamp.

scrambler_tracker_tail.name: Flat-track tail with number oval
scrambler_tracker_tail.description: Flat tail unit with an oval number board on the end.

scrambler_short_loop.name: Short loop, tiny fender
scrambler_short_loop.description: A short rear hoop with a tiny alloy fender.

sm_white_fender.name: White motard tail
sm_white_fender.description: White plastic tail with LED lamp.

sm_sport_tail.name: Short motard tail
sm_sport_tail.description: Short pointed tail with a strip lamp.

adv_rack_tail.name: Rack tail with LED
adv_rack_tail.description: Rear fender with an alloy rack.

tourer_halo.name: Touring guard with halo LED
tourer_halo.description: Full rear guard with ring LED.

tourer_rack_tail.name: Touring tail with rack
tourer_rack_tail.description: Tail tidy with a big rack.

flyscreen.name: Headlight flyscreen
flyscreen.description: A little cowl and screen over the headlight. Takes the wind off your chest, just.

headlight_cowl.name: Headlight cowl
headlight_cowl.description: A little round cowl over the headlamp with a tiny screen.

bikini_fairing.name: Bikini fairing
bikini_fairing.description: A small fairing round the headlight, on the forks, with a short screen. Classic 70s look.

batwing_fairing.name: Batwing fairing
batwing_fairing.description: The big fork-mounted batwing round the headlight with a tall screen.

seeley_half.name: Club racer half fairing
seeley_half.description: A round-nosed fibreglass half fairing in the 60s production racer style.

half_fairing.name: Half fairing
half_fairing.description: A creased, frame-mounted upper fairing with a proper screen. Calm at motorway speeds.

adventure_fairing.name: Adventure fairing, adjustable screen
adventure_fairing.description: A creased adventure fairing with a tall screen on rails: raise it on the motorway, drop it on the trail (Page Up / Page Down as you ride).

touring_fairing.name: Touring fairing
touring_fairing.description: A big frame-mounted fairing and a tall screen. Weatherproof and calm, but heavy and a lot of front to push.

race_fairing.name: Full sports fairing
race_fairing.description: Upper, sides and belly pan in fibreglass, with slim LED headlights and a winglet a side. Tuck in and it slips through the air.

carbon_race_fairing.name: Carbon race fairing
carbon_race_fairing.description: A carbon fibre race fairing: no lamps, a number board nose and two winglets a side. Half the weight, and slipperier still.

round_mirrors.name: Round chrome mirrors
round_mirrors.description: A pair of classic round mirrors on chrome stalks from the bar clamps.

bar_end_mirrors.name: Bar-end mirrors
bar_end_mirrors.description: Round mirrors hung off the ends of the bars. Clean lines on a cafe racer.

sport_mirrors.name: Sport stalk mirrors
sport_mirrors.description: Angular mirrors on long swept stalks, so you see past your elbows.

touring_mirrors.name: Wide touring mirrors
touring_mirrors.description: Big rectangular mirrors up high. You see everything behind you.

fairing_mirrors.name: Fairing-mount mirrors
fairing_mirrors.description: Slim mirror pods that bolt to the fairing, out of the wind. Needs a fairing fitted.

chrome_round_large.name: Large round chrome mirrors
chrome_round_large.description: Dinner plate mirrors on long chrome stalks. You'll see everything behind.

cafe_bar_end_large.name: Bar-end mirrors, large
cafe_bar_end_large.description: Big round bar-end mirrors on short arms.

bobber_mini_bar_end.name: Mini bar-end mirrors
bobber_mini_bar_end.description: Tiny round bar-end mirrors. Mostly for show.

chopper_mini_round.name: Small round chrome mirrors
chopper_mini_round.description: Small round mirrors on short chrome stalks.

road_hugger.name: Short road hugger
road_hugger.description: A short plastic guard that follows the top of the front tyre. Plain, light and painted to match the bike.

mx_high_fender.name: MX high fender
mx_high_fender.description: Bolted under the bottom yoke, well clear of the tyre so mud can't pack up and lock the wheel. Doesn't stop much spray.

enduro_front_fender.name: Enduro front fender
enduro_front_fender.description: A high fender with a longer tail and a lip at the front: clears the mud and still keeps some off the rider.

bobbed_steel.name: Bobbed steel blade
bobbed_steel.description: A stubby steel blade on a pair of round stays. Bobber style: more look than protection.

alloy_cafe_blade.name: Polished alloy cafe guard
alloy_cafe_blade.description: A slim polished aluminium blade on wire stays, as on a sixties cafe racer.

chrome_classic.name: Chrome classic mudguard
chrome_classic.description: A long, deeply valanced chrome guard with front and rear stays. Keeps the road off the engine and the rider's boots.

carbon_hugger.name: Carbon sport hugger
carbon_hugger.description: A race-style carbon-fibre guard hugging the tyre close. Feather light and dear.

valanced_painted_guard.name: Valanced front guard, painted
valanced_painted_guard.description: Deep valanced front guard painted to match, with a centre rib.

ribbed_alloy_guard.name: Ribbed alloy front guard
ribbed_alloy_guard.description: Polished alloy blade with a raised centre rib. Light and bright.

cafe_short_blade.name: Short alloy blade
cafe_short_blade.description: A short polished blade guard. Just enough.

bobber_stub_guard.name: Stub front guard
bobber_stub_guard.description: Barely covers the top of the tyre. Bobbed to the bone.

bobber_ribbed_bobbed.name: Ribbed bobbed guard, chrome
bobber_ribbed_bobbed.description: Short chrome front guard with a centre rib.

chopper_mini_blade.name: Mini chrome blade
chopper_mini_blade.description: A thin little chrome blade over the skinny front.

cruiser_full_valance.name: Full valanced front guard, chrome rib
cruiser_full_valance.description: Deep valanced guard with a chrome centre rib and stripe.

scrambler_high_steel.name: High chrome scrambler guard
scrambler_high_steel.description: A high-mounted chrome front guard like a 60s desert sled.

scrambler_alloy_low.name: Low brushed alloy guard
scrambler_alloy_low.description: A low brushed alloy blade with stays.

sm_low_hugger.name: Low motard hugger
sm_low_hugger.description: Low road hugger for a street motard.

adv_low_hugger.name: Low adventure guard
adv_low_hugger.description: Low road guard for a road-biased adventure bike.

unleaded_95.name: Unleaded petrol (95)
unleaded_95.description: Pump fuel in a 5 litre jerry can.

unleaded_95_20l.name: Unleaded petrol (95), 20 litres
unleaded_95_20l.description: Pump fuel in a big 20 litre jerry can: a few tank-fulls for the shed.

super_98.name: Super unleaded (98)
super_98.description: Higher octane. A touch more power and a little further per tank.

super_98_20l.name: Super unleaded (98), 20 litres
super_98_20l.description: Higher octane in a big 20 litre jerry can.

race_fuel.name: Race fuel (102)
race_fuel.description: Leaded race fuel. Strong but thirsty.

race_fuel_25l.name: Race fuel (102), 25 litres
race_fuel_25l.description: Leaded race fuel in a 25 litre drum, for a race weekend.

empty_jerry_can.name: Empty jerry can
empty_jerry_can.description: For draining a tank. Holds 10 litres.

empty_jerry_can_20l.name: Empty 20 litre jerry can
empty_jerry_can_20l.description: For draining a tank, or carrying a lot of fuel. Holds 20 litres.

mineral_20w50.name: Mineral oil 20W-50
mineral_20w50.description: Thick old-school oil, 4 litres. Fine for classics.

synthetic_5w40.name: Fully synthetic 5W-40
synthetic_5w40.description: Best protection and the least friction, 4 litres.

drain_pan.name: Oil drain pan
drain_pan.description: Slide it under the engine to drain old oil. Holds 6 litres.

dot3.name: DOT 3 brake fluid
dot3.description: Basic fluid, half a litre. Boils early under hard braking.

dot4.name: DOT 4 brake fluid
dot4.description: The usual choice, half a litre.

dot51.name: DOT 5.1 brake fluid
dot51.description: High boiling point, half a litre. Firmest lever.

bleed_bottle.name: Brake bleed bottle
bleed_bottle.description: Catches old fluid when you bleed the brakes. Holds 1 litre.

road_lube.name: Road chain lube
road_lube.description: Sticky spray lube for road riding.

wax_lube.name: Chain wax
wax_lube.description: Dries to a clean wax. Doesn't fling, lasts well on the road.

dry_ptfe.name: Dry PTFE lube
dry_ptfe.description: For dusty trails: grit doesn't stick to it, but it wears off sooner.

race_lube.name: Race chain lube
race_lube.description: Ultra-low friction, short life. For race day.

stalk_amber.name: Amber stalk indicators
stalk_amber.description: Four plain amber indicators on rubber stalks, front and back. What most road bikes left the factory with.

bullet_chrome.name: Chrome bullet indicators
bullet_chrome.description: Little chrome bullets with amber lenses. Neat on a café racer or a custom.

mini_led.name: Mini LED indicators
mini_led.description: Tiny black LED blinkers on short stalks. Clean lines, bright enough to pass.

flush_led.name: Flush-mount LED indicators
flush_led.description: LEDs set into the bodywork and the tail tidy, so there's nothing to snap off in a crash.

touring_large.name: Big touring indicators
touring_large.description: Large square indicators on long stalks, seen from a long way off in the rain.

classic_bullet_amber.name: Chrome bullet indicators, amber
classic_bullet_amber.description: Little chrome bullets with amber lenses.

triangle_classic.name: Classic triangle side panels
triangle_classic.description: Painted panels filling the triangle under the seat, hiding the battery and the wiring.

oval_number.name: Oval number side panels
oval_number.description: Flat-track style oval panels with a white number board. A café or a tracker look.

mx_plate.name: MX side plates
mx_plate.description: Big plastic side plates over the airbox and shock, one piece with the number boards.

sport_cowl.name: Sport side cowls
sport_cowl.description: Sculpted side cowls joining the tank to the tail, the way a sports bike's bodywork flows.

battery_cover_chrome.name: Chrome battery cover
battery_cover_chrome.description: A chrome cover over the battery box and the oil tank. Custom cruiser bling.

classic_toolbox_panels.name: Toolbox side panels
classic_toolbox_panels.description: Triangular panels with a toolbox lid on one side, painted to match.

chopper_chrome_oil.name: Chrome horseshoe cover
chopper_chrome_oil.description: A chrome cover over the oil tank and battery.

scrambler_oval_panels.name: Scrambler side covers, white
scrambler_oval_panels.description: Plain white side covers with a little badge.

road_pegs.name: Rubber road footpegs
road_pegs.description: Plain rubber-topped pegs on the frame's own hangers, with a brake pedal and gear lever.

alloy_rearsets.name: Billet alloy rearsets
alloy_rearsets.description: Knurled alloy pegs on hanger plates set high and back, for a tucked-in sports riding position.

mx_cleats.name: MX cleated pegs
mx_cleats.description: Wide steel pegs with teeth, so a muddy boot doesn't slip off standing up.

forward_controls.name: Forward controls
forward_controls.description: Pegs and pedals pushed way out in front on long brackets, so you ride with your feet out.

floorboards.name: Rider footboards
floorboards.description: Big rubber-topped boards instead of pegs, for miles of comfort on a tourer or cruiser.

cafe_rearsets_polished.name: Polished cafe rearsets
cafe_rearsets_polished.description: Polished billet rearsets set high and back.

bobber_mid_pegs.name: Black mid-forward controls
bobber_mid_pegs.description: Black controls a little forward of standard. Relaxed but not stretched.

chopper_highway_pegs.name: Highway pegs, chrome
chopper_highway_pegs.description: Chrome forward controls stretched way out.

engine_bars.name: Tubular engine bars
engine_bars.description: Chrome hoops either side of the engine, so a tip-over in the car park doesn't crack a case.

adv_cage.name: Adventure crash cage
adv_cage.description: Black tubular bars round the engine and up round the tank, for dropping it off-road far from help.

bash_plate.name: Alloy bash plate
bash_plate.description: A thick alloy plate under the engine to take the rocks.

frame_sliders.name: Frame sliders
frame_sliders.description: Nylon bobbins on the frame bolts. In a low-side they slide instead of the bodywork.

skid_plate_mx.name: MX skid plate
skid_plate_mx.description: A plastic skid plate under the frame rails, light and tough, to slide over logs.

scrambler_sump_plate.name: Brushed sump guard
scrambler_sump_plate.description: A brushed alloy plate under the engine.

mx_carbon_skid.name: Carbon skid plate
mx_carbon_skid.description: A carbon skid plate under the frame.

wrap_bars.name: Wrap-around crash bars
wrap_bars.description: One long chrome hoop a side, wrapped from the head stock round the front of the engine and back under it to the footpegs.

mx_side_boards.name: MX number boards
mx_side_boards.description: A front plate on the bars and two side boards under the seat, all with race numbers.

front_plate_race.name: Front race plate
front_plate_race.description: A single number plate on the bars, over the headlight. Supermoto and scrambler racers wear one.

radiator_shrouds.name: Radiator shrouds
radiator_shrouds.description: Plastic wings either side of the tank, steering air through the radiators and your knees off them.

oval_race_plates.name: Oval race plates
oval_race_plates.description: White oval number plates on the nose and the tail, like a club racer from the sixties.

flat_track_boards.name: Flat-track number boards
flat_track_boards.description: Big side number boards in a tracker's yellow, with the tail cut short behind them.

cafe_oval_plates.name: Painted oval race plates
cafe_oval_plates.description: Cream oval number plates for the sides of the tail.

box_steel_black.name: Steel box-section swingarm
box_steel_black.description: Deep tapered box-section steel arms in black, with slotted axle blocks and bolt-up chain adjusters. Stiffer than the frame's flat bars.

box_alloy_polished.name: Polished alloy box-section arm
box_alloy_polished.description: A polished aluminium box-section arm, the classic upgrade for a café racer or a naked: lighter and stiffer, and it shines.

banana_steel.name: Banana swingarm
banana_steel.description: Steel arms bowed up in a long curve so the exhaust can tuck in underneath, as on the two-stroke racers of the seventies.

banana_alloy_gold.name: Gold anodised banana arm
banana_alloy_gold.description: A gold anodised alloy banana arm: the right-hand side curves high over the pipe. Light, stiff and loud to look at.

braced_mx_alloy.name: Braced MX swingarm
braced_mx_alloy.description: A tall alloy motocross arm with a truss braced underneath, a rubber chain slider and a chain guide. Built to take landings.

braced_mx_black.name: Black braced enduro arm
braced_mx_black.description: A black braced arm for an enduro or adventure bike: the truss under each side keeps it straight when it's loaded up off-road.

hardtail_chrome.name: Chrome hardtail rear end
hardtail_chrome.description: No suspension at all: chromed chain stays and seat stays bolted rigid to the frame, for the low, hard look of a proper bobber or chopper.

hardtail_black.name: Black hardtail rear end
hardtail_black.description: A rigid rear triangle in satin black. The shocks are hidden away under the seat, so it looks like the old hardtails but rides a little kinder.

single_sided_alloy.name: Single-sided alloy swingarm
single_sided_alloy.description: A deep cast alloy single-sided arm with the wheel on one big centre nut, the right-hand side of the wheel left bare. Quick wheel changes and that look.

single_sided_black.name: Black single-sided arm
single_sided_black.description: A black single-sided arm for a modern naked or a sports tourer: the whole rear wheel on show from the right.

single_gull_alloy.name: Gull-wing single-sided swingarm
single_gull_alloy.description: A deep cast alloy single-sided arm that bows up and out over the exhaust, with lightening holes cast through it and an eccentric hub for the chain. The back wheel hangs off one big centre nut, the right-hand side left bare.

single_gull_black.name: Gull-wing single-sided swingarm, black
single_gull_black.description: The gull-wing single-sided arm in satin black, the right-hand side of the wheel left bare to show it off.

damper_friction.name: Friction steering damper
damper_friction.description: The old way: a knob under the bottom yoke squeezes friction plates. Steadies the bars on rough roads, but makes them stiff at walking pace too.

damper_linear.name: Basic linear steering damper
damper_linear.description: A simple oil damper from the frame to the bottom yoke. Takes the edge off a shaky front end. No adjuster.

damper_linear_adj.name: Adjustable linear steering damper
damper_linear_adj.description: Oil damper alongside the tank with a click adjuster on the end: soft for town, firm for fast bumpy roads.

damper_rotary_race.name: Rotary race steering damper
damper_rotary_race.description: Sits on the top yoke and damps the bars through a vane in oil. Firm and precise, the racer's choice to stop a tank-slapper.

damper_offroad.name: Off-road bar-clamp damper
damper_offroad.description: Rotary damper under the bar clamps that stops ruts and rocks ripping the bars out of your hands.

mag_tank_bag_8.name: Magnetic tank bag, 8 L
mag_tank_bag_8.description: A low soft bag that sticks to a steel tank with magnets in its base. Wallet, phone and a sandwich.

mag_tank_bag_15.name: Expanding magnetic tank bag, 15 L
mag_tank_bag_15.description: Zips out from 11 to 15 litres, with a clear map pocket on top. Sticks to a steel tank.

strap_tank_bag_10.name: Strap-on tank bag, 10 L
strap_tank_bag_10.description: Buckles round the steering head and under the seat, so it sits on any tank, plastic ones too.

rally_tank_bag.name: Rally tank bag with map window
rally_tank_bag.description: A tough strap-on bag with a big clear window on top for a paper map, and side pockets for the jerky.

ring_tank_bag_6.name: Quick-lock tank bag, 6 L
ring_tank_bag_6.description: Clicks onto a ring under the filler cap and off again in a second to fill up. Small and neat.

bladder_tank_6.name: Fuel bladder, 6 L
bladder_tank_6.description: A tough rubberised bag strapped across the back, with a hose and tap to top up the main tank.

rack_can_5.name: Rack-mounted fuel can, 5 L
rack_can_5.description: A flat red steel can on a bracket off the pannier rail. Five litres to get you to the next town.

rail_cell_8.name: Pannier-rail fuel cell, 8 L
rail_cell_8.description: A slim alloy tank along the pannier rail, plumbed into the main tank with a pump.

rear_rally_tank_10.name: Rear rally tank, 10 L
rear_rally_tank_10.description: A moulded plastic tank behind the seat under the rack, rally style. Keeps the weight low and central-ish.

twin_side_tanks_14.name: Twin rally side tanks, 14 L
twin_side_tanks_14.description: A pair of tanks low either side of the engine, ahead of your shins, Dakar style. Fourteen litres more, carried low.

tool_roll_pouch.name: Leather tool roll
tool_roll_pouch.description: A rolled leather pouch strapped to the fork. Room for a few things.

tool_tube.name: Tool tube
tool_tube.description: A screw-capped plastic tube on the pannier rail. Keeps the tools dry.

bash_toolbox.name: Bash plate toolbox
bash_toolbox.description: A sealed alloy box built into the bash plate, low down where the weight doesn't matter.

alloy_toolbox.name: Aluminium toolbox
alloy_toolbox.description: A lockable alloy box bolted to the rack beside the rear wheel.

expedition_tool_case.name: Expedition tool case
expedition_tool_case.description: A big black case on the rack with room for the lot: tools, spares, fluids and a pump.

phone_nav_mount.name: Phone sat nav, handlebar clip
phone_nav_mount.description: Your phone in a sprung cradle on a clamp round the bar, running a nav app: the map, the way and the next turn, on any bike. It buzzes a bit with the engine.

compact_gps.name: Compact moto sat nav, 3.5"
compact_gps.description: A small rugged sat nav on a ball mount. Shows the road ahead and how far to go.

road_gps.name: Road sat nav, 4.3"
road_gps.description: A motorcycle sat nav on a RAM arm: glove-friendly buttons, the road ahead and the next fuel.

adventure_gps.name: Adventure sat nav, 5"
adventure_gps.description: A big rugged unit in an armoured cradle on a crossbar above the clocks: map, fuel stops and where you're headed.

rally_tablet.name: Rally tablet, 8"
rally_tablet.description: A rally tower's big tablet on a navigation bar: the whole route in front of you, with fuel and stops.

lever_guard_carbon_race.name: Carbon race lever guard
lever_guard_carbon_race.description: The hoop racing rules ask for: a carbon arm off the right bar end that curves round in front of the brake lever, so another bike's bars can't pull it on in a pack.

lever_guard_billet_black.name: Black billet lever guards
lever_guard_billet_black.description: A pair of black anodised alloy hoops off the bar ends, one in front of the brake lever and one the clutch, to save them in a tip-over.

lever_guard_red.name: Red anodised lever guards
lever_guard_red.description: Bright red alloy hoops for both levers, bolted to the bar ends. Loud, and they keep the levers whole when it goes down.

lever_guard_gold.name: Gold anodised lever guard
lever_guard_gold.description: A gold alloy brake lever guard with a bar-end weight, the finishing touch on a race replica.

lever_guard_street.name: Short street lever guard
lever_guard_street.description: A short polished alloy hoop off the right bar end, just enough to keep the brake lever off the tarmac if it's dropped.
